info.title: PNLCS API
info.description: The PNLCS billing and client management API. Every call is answered as the staff account the credential belongs to, with that account's permissions.

post.description: What the Accept button does: every service on the order is created on its server (products set to manual setup included), ordered domains are registered, and the order becomes Active. A service whose server refuses stays pending and is queued for retry. Permission: manage_orders.

post.summary: Accept a quote and raise its invoice
post.description: Raises the invoice, as the client Accept button does. Accepting an accepted quote changes nothing. Permission: manage_quotes.
The same switch as Setup > Modules in the admin area. Permission: manage_settings.

moduleType.description: server, gateway, registrar, ssl or addon.

moduleName.description: The module name, for example stripe.

published.description: Default true. Send 0 to save it unpublished.

ip.description: An IPv4 or IPv6 address, or a prefix ending in * such as 203.0.113.*

type.description: Immediate, or End of Billing Period (the default).

email.description: Must not belong to another client.

password2.description: At least 8 characters. When sent, a client-area login is created with it. password is accepted too.

userid.description: The client. clientid is accepted too.

note.description: The note. notes and message are accepted too.

sticky.description: Pin it to the top of the client summary.

transid.description: The payment reference. The same reference is never recorded twice.

gateway.description: The gateway it came through. Default banktransfer.

pid.description: Product ids: pid[0], pid[1], ... At least one.

billingcycle.description: One per product: monthly (default), quarterly, semiannually, annually, biennially, triennially or onetime. A cycle the product is not sold on is skipped.

domain.description: One per product: the domain the service is for.

priceoverride.description: One per product: a price instead of the product price (0 or more).

paymentmethod.description: A gateway installed here. Default banktransfer.

type.description: hostingaccount, reselleraccount, server or other (hosting, reseller, vps, ssl, other are accepted too).

module.description: The server module that provisions it, for example panelica.

autosetup.description: order (set up when ordered; on is accepted too), payment, or manual.

pricing.description: pricing[currencyid][cycle]=price, cycles monthly to triennially; -1 means not sold on that cycle.

projectid.description: The project. project_id is accepted too.
The project. project_id is accepted too.

task.description: The task, up to 255 characters. title is accepted too.

module.description: An SSL module installed here, for example gogetssl.

cert_type.description: The certificate product at the provider.

domain.description: The name it is for; *.example.com for a wildcard.

message.description: The note. Staff only; the client never sees it.

adminusername.description: Any value: the reply is from staff, signed by the staff member the credential belongs to. Left out, the reply is the client's.

userid.description: For a client reply: which client. Default: the ticket's client.

email.description: Must not belong to another login.

clientid.description: Attach the new login to this client account.

invoiceid.description: The invoice to pay from credit.

amount.description: At least 0.01, and no more than the client credit balance.

clientid.description: When sent, must be the owner of the invoice.

ticketid.description: The ticket whose sender to block.

admin_first_name.description: Contact details the provider asks for: admin_first_name, admin_last_name, admin_email, admin_phone, admin_org, admin_address, admin_city, admin_state, admin_zip, admin_country.

clientid.description: The client account. client_id is accepted too.

permissions.description: all (the default), or a comma-separated list of: profile, contacts, products, manageproducts, productsso, domains, managedomains, invoices, quotes, tickets, affiliates, emails, orders.

items.description: The lines: items[0][description], items[0][amount], items[0][taxed] (default true). Or send itemdescription1, itemamount1, itemtaxed1, itemdescription2, ... (up to 50). At least one line is required.

allowed_ips.description: The addresses it may be used from: IPv4 or IPv6 addresses and CIDR ranges, separated by commas (or an array). Left out, it works from anywhere.

extension.description: The extension, with or without the dot: .com or com.

userid.description: The client. clientid is accepted too.

items.description: The lines: items[0][description], items[0][quantity] (default 1), items[0][unit_price], items[0][discount], items[0][taxable].

client_id.description: The client account. clientid is accepted too.

user_id.description: Which login to sign in as. Default: the account owner. userid is accepted too.

destination.description: clientarea:homepage (default), clientarea:invoices, clientarea:services, clientarea:domains, clientarea:tickets, clientarea:product_details (with service_id), clientarea:domain_details (with domain_id) or sso:custom_redirect (with sso_redirect_path).

service_id.description: For clientarea:product_details; must be on the account.

domain_id.description: For clientarea:domain_details; must be on the account.

sso_redirect_path.description: For sso:custom_redirect: a path inside the client area, such as /client/invoices.

moduleType.description: server, gateway, registrar, ssl or addon.

paymethodid.description: One of that client's stored methods.

clientid.description: The client account to take it off.

registrar.description: A registrar module installed here. Default manual.

idprotect.description: The state you want. Left out, the current state is flipped.

eppcode.description: The transfer code from the current registrar.

clientid.description: The client the entry is about.

packageid.description: The product to move the account to.

servicepassword.description: The new password, at least 6 characters. password is accepted too.

func_name.description: A function the service's server module lists in customFunctions().

reason.description: Stored as the suspension reason and passed to the server module.

clientid.description: The client, when the sender is one. userid is accepted too.

name.description: The sender name, for a guest.

adminusername.description: Any value: the ticket is opened by staff.

email.description: The client login. Required unless id is sent.

id.description: The login (user) id. Required unless email is sent.

deptid.description: Only the staff who handle this support department.

messagename.description: A template, one of: invoice created, invoice payment confirmation, invoice reminder, invoice overdue, service welcome email, service suspension, service unsuspension, service termination, order confirmation, domain registration confirmation, domain renewal reminder, account signup email. Required unless customsubject is sent.

id.description: The record the mail is about: an invoice, service, order, domain or client id, as the template or customtype needs.

customsubject.description: Write the mail yourself instead of using a template. Required unless messagename is sent.

custommessage.description: The body, when customsubject is sent.

customtype.description: What id points at for a custom mail: general (a client, the default), invoice, product (a service) or domain.

projectid.description: When sent, the task must belong to this project.

url.description: A link to add to the notification.

notification_identifier.description: Your own label for the notification.

notes.description: The admin notes. Replaces what was there.

email.description: Must not belong to another client.

status.description: pending, active, suspended, terminated, cancelled, fraud or completed. cancelled stops its billing too.
pending, active, grace, redemption, expired, cancelled, fraud or transferred_away.
pending, active, suspended, terminated, cancelled, fraud or completed.

username.description: The account user name on the server.

password.description: The account password as stored in PNLCS. This does not change it on the server; use modulechangepw for that.

billing_cycle.description: onetime, monthly, quarterly, semiannually, annually, biennially or triennially.

status.description: draft, unpaid, paid, partially_paid, overdue, cancelled, refunded, collections or payment_pending.

gateway.description: With status=paid: the gateway it was paid through. Default manual.

moduleType.description: gateway, registrar, ssl or addon. Server modules keep their settings on each server.

parameters.description: parameters[name]=value for each setting to change, up to 50, each a string of at most 8192 characters.

allowed_ips.description: Replace the addresses it may be used from (see createoauthcredential). Send it empty to allow anywhere.

paymethodid.description: One of that client's stored methods.

projectid.description: The project. id is accepted too.

task.description: Up to 255 characters. title is accepted too.

completed.description: Mark it done or not done.

status.description: Draft, Sent, Accepted or Declined (exactly as written).
One of the ticket statuses configured here (any letter case).

flag.description: Assign it to this staff account (admin id).

message.description: The new text. Cannot be empty.

status.description: New, In Progress, Completed or Deferred (any letter case).

due_date.description: YYYY-MM-DD, or empty to clear it.

admin.description: The staff member it is assigned to.

email.description: Must not belong to another login.

userid.description: The login. user_id is accepted too.

clientid.description: The client account. client_id is accepted too.

permissions.description: all, or a comma-separated list (see createclientinvite).
